c.title: Categories
c.desc: Last {n} full months ({from} to {to}), per category. Click a row to see more.
c.renText: Changes it on every transaction, rule, budget, bill and jar. If a category with the new name already exists, the two become one.
c.delQ: Delete "{k}"? Its transactions become uncategorized, and its rules and budget are removed.
c.dup: There is already a category named "{k}".

g.title: Tags
g.desc: Last {n} full months ({from} to {to}), per tag. Click a row to see more.
g.appear: Add a tag above, add tags when you open a transaction, or let a tag rule add them automatically.
g.renText: Changes it on every transaction and in every tag rule. If a tag with the new name already exists, they become one.
g.delQ: Delete the tag "{g}"? It is removed from {n} transaction and from tag rules. The transactions stay. | Delete the tag "{g}"? It is removed from {n} transactions and from tag rules. The transactions stay.
g.dup: There is already a tag named #{g}.

rulesAt: Rules that sort entries automatically are in Settings → Automatic sorting.

row.rulesTip: Rules that put transactions here. Click to see them in Settings.

open.monthTip: {m}: {out} out, {in} in. Click to see them in Activity.

ai.text: An AI can suggest categories and tags from the names of your own transactions.

tip.thisM: This calendar month so far: the money out (for income: the money in). Not changed by the time picked above.
tip.lastM: The whole of last calendar month: the money out (for income: the money in). Not changed by the time picked above.
tip.avg: A usual month: the money out (for income: the money in) in the last {n} full months ({from} to {to}), divided by {n}. Based on the time picked above.
tip.out: Total money out in the last {n} full months ({from} to {to}), the time picked above.
tip.in: Total money in in the last {n} full months ({from} to {to}), the time picked above.
tip.net: Money in minus money out in the last {n} full months ({from} to {to}), the time picked above.
tip.change: The last {n} full months ({from} to {to}) against the {n} months before them. Based on the time picked above.
tip.n: How many transactions in the last {n} full months ({from} to {to}), the time picked above.
tip.last: The date of the latest transaction.
tip.budget: The most you plan to spend here each month, set in Budgets.
tip.rules: How many rules put transactions here automatically.
